messages:
Micah: Heads up — planning a small catalog rollover tonight 21:00 PT. We want to swap alias \"text-gen-compact\" from model v2.1.0 -> v2.2.0-lite (quantized). Who's available to do the deploy and own smoke/rollback?

Jon: I can do the deploy and monitor runtime metrics. What's the quiet window and canary split? :eyes:

Zara: I'll reserve slot and open quiet window 20:45-22:15 PT. Canary at 5% for first 15m. Please @me 10m before deploy.

Micah: Plan sketch: start canary at 20:50 PT, ramp 5% -> 20% over 10m, evaluate, then 21:05 full swap if no regressions. Smoke checklist below.

Liam: Adding oncall — I'll watch latency, OOMs, error rate. If p50 latency > 2x baseline OR error rate > 1% we rollback immediately.

Micah: Smoke checklist (short):
- quick request correctness (sanity prompts)
- perf smoke: p50/p95 on small batch of requests
- integration quick-run (key flows)
- validate reranker/embeds toy queries
- confirm catalog alias points to expected model id and checksum

Micah: Quick smoke commands (run from devbox):
```bash
# sanity generation
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"model":"text-gen-compact","input":"summarize: The quick brown fox"}' | jq .

# long-context check (8k-ish)
python - <<'PY'
print('x'*7000)
PY
```

Micah: Rollback quick steps (if needed):
```bash
# revert catalog alias to previous model id (example)
redwood catalog alias set text-gen-compact --model-id m-2.1.0 --reason \"rollback: latency spike\"
# restart proxy if sticky
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-proxy -n inference
```

Jon: Ack. I'll kick the canary at 20:48 PT so warm caches are ready. I'll paste smoke outputs here and the trace links. I'll also run the 8k token prompt and a couple heavy KV tests.

Zara: I'll create fallback route and a 5% split policy in the routing config before canary. Also pre-create the rollback alias so it's a one-liner to flip.

deploy-bot: deploy created — id dpl_20260318_21_00, canary policy attached, logs stream: https://deploys.redwood.ai/dpl_20260318_21_00

Liam: Merged catalog PR #4321 with model metadata changes. Running quick unit smoke now. :thumbsup:

Jon: One heads-up — the quant variant uses different KV cache alignment; watch for token drops on very long prompts (we'll verify with the 8k test). Also p95 might be slightly higher for some workloads.

Micah: Good call. Add a test in the smoke run: send the same conversation twice and check for consistent prefixes.

Zara: I'll also run a low-load ab-style test at 5% after 10m to validate latency tail.

Micah: If anyone sees anomalies during the ramp call rollback and paste the reason + trace link. I'll be online 20:40-21:30 to coordinate.

Micah: @Zara @Jon @Liam — thanks all, will ping 20:40 for final go/no-go. See you tonight :coffee:
